(ORDER LIST: 610 U.S.) 
WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 21, 2026 
ORDER IN PENDING CASE 
26A416 TRUMP, PRESIDENT OF U.S., ET AL. V. KINGDOM, ALISHEA S., ET AL. 
The application for stay presented to The Chief Justice and 
by him referred to the Court is denied. 
Justice Thomas and Justice Alito would grant the 
application for stay.
